title: Taylor Swift Joined by Caitlin Clark at Sunday’s Chiefs Game
summary: Este Haim and Donna Kelce (Travis' mom) were also spotted with Swift at the Oct. 18 Chiefs vs. Chargers game in Kansas City.
contentText:
Following Taylor Swift ‘s Saturday night performance in Los Angeles , where she played a song from The Life of a Showgirl live for the first time, the superstar arrived in Kansas City to take in the Chiefs-Chargers game Sunday night (Oct. 18).

Related

Taylor Swift’s ‘The Life of a Showgirl’ Rules Billboard 200 for 15th Week

Taylor Swift, The Beatles, Elvis & More Artists With the Most Weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard 200: Full List

Taylor Swift Stuns in Strapless Blue Gown at 2026 Academy Museum Gala

Swift was in good company in a suite at Arrowhead Stadium, with pals Caitlin Clark and Este Haim by her side. Travis Kelce’s mom, Donna, was also in attendance; Swift was seen giving her mother-in-law a hug.

She went luxury designer-casual in red in support of the Kansas City Chiefs, who played the Los Angeles Chargers. Swift’s outfit was built around a bright red Louis Vuitton turtleneck bodysuit, which she paired with black bottoms and her matching red signature lip.

Swift surprised the audience at the 2026 Academy Museum Gala with the live debut of “The Fate of Ophelia” during a short set on Saturday. Though it’s been more than a year since the Showgirl single’s release, fans had yet to see her perform “Ophelia,” or any track from the chart-topping collection, until this weekend. She also performed “I Knew It, I Knew You,” plus longtime hits “Blank Space” and “Love Story.”

The Life of a Showgirl returns to No. 1 on the Billboard 200 this week. The album returned to the top after Swift added four new bonus tracks — “Patient Zero” (which also got the music video treatment), “Pink Clouding,” “Cleveland!” and “Babylon” — to a deluxe edition of the original LP in a late September 2026 release. It’s now accumulated a total of 15 nonconsecutive weeks on the chart.
